feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi pa kumpirmado ang paaralan; markahan itong "kailangang kumpirmahin" hanggang masuri.
feedback_by_option.en: The school is not confirmed; mark it "verify locally" until it is checked.

feedback_by_option.fil: Sa hiwalay na tatlong layer, kita ang alam na at ang kailangan pang suriin.
feedback_by_option.en: Keeping the three layers apart shows what is known and what still needs checking.

feedback_by_option.fil: Pangangailangan ang nasa mapa, hindi pangalan; igalang ang privacy ng sambahayan.
feedback_by_option.en: The map shows the need, not the name; protect household privacy.

feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi pa kumpirmado ang paaralan.
feedback_by_option.en: This may harm or delay help: the school is still not confirmed.

feedback_by_option.fil: Beripikadong mapa lang ang dapat gumabay sa tao; itala kung sino at kailan nagpatunay.
feedback_by_option.en: Only a verified map should guide people; record who verified it and when.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi opisyal na hazard map o evacuation order ang mapa ng pagsasanay.
feedback_by_option.en: The practice map is not an official hazard map or evacuation order.
